model.name: Class action-bar verbs completion: rename / delete / new-class in ACTIONS_BY_TYPE for a selected class (fulfilling Tron item-5 full set)
model.description: Follow-up capture of the R33.6.5 item-5 GAP (PO-directed 2026-07-31, so it is TRACKED not lost). Tron round-2 item-5 spec listed the class action-bar verbs as 'rename / remove-from-diagram / delete / new-class', but only ADD-to-diagram (R33.6.5) + REMOVE-from-diagram (R33.8, building) shipped. RENAME / DELETE / NEW-CLASS are NOT yet built = the remaining gap in fulfilling item-5. This req captures the 3 remaining class-action verbs in the R33.6.5 selection-driven action bar (ACTIONS_BY_TYPE.modelelement). ★ DELETE here is DISTINCT from R33.8 remove-from-diagram: R33.8 drops only the diagram VIEW-LINK (element stays); R33.9 DELETE removes the ModelElement UNIT itself (with the appropriate guard/confirm). Reuse the R33.6.5 ACTIONS_BY_TYPE + drawer action-bar + verb-dispatch (wireDrawerActions) pattern, NO fork. NOT dispatched to build - PO is surfacing the PRIORITY to Tron (build-now vs defer). Architect designs the chain IF/when Tron prioritizes.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (round-2 item-5, via R33.6.5 spec): class selected -> rename / remove-from-diagram / delete / new-class. (Only add+remove shipped; rename/delete/new-class = this follow-up.)

model.crossRefNote: Completes the R33.6.5 (3c6eee8d) action-bar class-action set alongside R33.8 remove-from-diagram (86219c51). Reuse ACTIONS_BY_TYPE.modelelement + wireDrawerActions verb-dispatch.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A class/element selected on a diagram shows a 'Rename' action in the R33.6.5 action bar (ACTIONS_BY_TYPE.modelelement) -> renames the ModelElement (updates model.name in MODEL_STORE, store-only, prod untouched) -> the box label + tree node reflect the new name.

A selected class shows a 'Delete' action -> DELETES the ModelElement UNIT itself from MODEL_STORE (with a guard/confirm) - DISTINCT from R33.8 remove-from-diagram (which drops only the diagram view-link). Delete removes the element + its views + relationships; store-only, prod scenario/index untouched. (Guard: confirm before delete; architect scopes the exact guard.)

The action bar shows a 'New class' action -> creates a NEW ModelElement (class) unit in MODEL_STORE (store-only) and optionally add-views it onto the open diagram (architect scopes add-to-diagram-on-create).

GATE @390 (screenshot/pixel + planted bite + Tron device) per verb: select a class -> Rename -> label updates; Delete -> element gone from model+diagram (guard fired); New class -> a new class unit appears. planted: rename/new-class writes prod scenario/index, or delete leaves orphans/hits the wrong unit = RED.
